entities.name: Kayla bin-Kroog
entities.description: Princess of Yotia, wife of Urza, later Lady of Penregon and the last Queen of Argive.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Artificer who married Kayla and later ascended.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Urza's brother who seduced Kayla and destroyed Kroog.

entities.name: Harbin
entities.description: Kayla's son, whose parentage was in doubt.

entities.name: Tawnos
entities.description: Urza's favored student and Kayla's friend who destroyed Urza's archives.

entities.name: Penregon
entities.description: City Kayla ruled after the war.

entities.name: Mightstone
entities.description: Urza's powerstone, stolen by Kayla at Mishra's urging.

events.summary: Urza wins Kayla's hand by having his automaton move a great statue.
Urza and Kayla grow close after her father's death.
Mishra convinces Kayla to steal Urza's Mightstone and sleep with him; Urza discovers them, reclaims the stone and declares war.
events.quote: he convinced Kayla to steal Urza's Mightstone and sleep with him

events.summary: Mishra returns with his army and dragon engines and destroys Kroog; Kayla flees pregnant with Harbin.
events.quote: In one morning, Kroog was destroyed

events.summary: Kayla rules Penregon, rebuilds with Tawnos's automatons, and the Church of Tal besieges the city.
events.quote: initiated the Siege of Penregon in 69 AR

events.summary: Tawnos destroys Urza's archives and leaves, ending the age of artifice in Penregon.
events.quote: the repentant Tawnos destroyed Urza's archives and left the city

events.summary: Kayla leads the refugees west in 79 AR as Penregon falls.
events.quote: with the Fall of Penregon happening that autumn

events.summary: Kayla resolves to cross the continent hoping the legendary flying man is her son Harbin.
events.quote: Kayla resolved to cross the continent to learn the truth

relations.quote: She was the daughter of the Warlord of Kroog
